subject: MAP milestones, reserve sizing & burst terms for dedicated pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Carter <emma.carter@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot / MAP + Dedicated capacity questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We talked internally and want to scope a short dedicated pilot to evaluate performance and unit economics ahead of a broader rollout. High-level ask: a 6-8 week evaluation with goals around 99th-percentile latency < 250ms at our 75th-percentile QPS, and embeddings throughput for nightly batch reranks.

Can you share a proposed MAP (milestones + acceptance criteria) and a provisional pricing outline for a reserved GPU pool? We're thinking in the ballpark of an 8-GPU pool (A100-equivalent) with the ability to burst to 12 GPUs for short windows during profiling/ramp. Important commercial constraints:
- Target contract term we can consider: 12 months (open to 24).
- Budget: prefer committed monthly billing vs on-demand.
- Need clarity on burst pricing (how much premium, caps) and early termination terms.

Also looping in Emma (platform PM) and Priya (procurement/legal) for timeline visibility. Our procurement window is tight — we'd like to conclude commercials in ~2 weeks if MAP is acceptable.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of ML Platforms | Acme AI

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.ai>
Cc: Emma Carter <emma.carter@acme.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot / MAP + Dedicated capacity questions

Jordan — appreciate the context and timeline. Draft below is what we typically propose for a dedicated evaluation that maps to commercial milestones (summary first, then details).

Summary (proposal):
- Dedicated pool: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved, burst to 12 GPUs up to 2 hours/day or 20 hours/month aggregated.
- Term: 12-month reservation with an initial 8-week evaluation (pilot). Pricing: list price for 8 GPUs reserved, with a ramp discount schedule: 8% off list at 3-month average utilization >= 55%, 12% off at 6-month average utilization >= 70%, and an additional 5% loyalty discount for 12+ month term. Burst usage billed at 1.5x reserved rate, capped at the monthly burst cap.
- MAP / acceptance: kickoff + baseline (week 0-1), stress profiling & quantization tests (weeks 2-4), integration + latency/sign-off (weeks 5-6), production trial (weeks 7-8). Commercially: signing SOW and reservation before week 4 locks these pricing terms and burst caps.
- Onboarding credit: one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of committed monthly reservation for first invoice.

Details / Milestones:
- Week 0: Kickoff, access, run baseline workloads (target: baseline latency/QPS).
- Week 1: Measurement and target-setting; agree on pass/fail thresholds (99p latency, throughput).
- Weeks 2–4: Stress tests (scale QPS, test cache-warming, KV-cache profiling). If quantization is part of the plan we will run a quantization validation track with a controlled quality gate (WER/embedding sim threshold).
- Week 5: Integration, sample production traffic, validate fallbacks and routing.
- Week 6–8: Production trial window; acceptance if agreed KPIs are met for a 48–72 hour stability window.

Commercial notes:
- Reservation sizing: we can size by vGPU hours or full GPU units. For your workload snapshot, 8 GPUs is a conservative start; we can scale to 12 as a burst band.
- Burst clause: 50% additional capacity (8->12 GPUs) available short-term. If you need more burst hours, we can expand the monthly burst cap; pricing for burst above included cap is at 1.7x.
- Early termination: pro-rated exit fee based on remaining committed months and a 60-day notice.

Next steps:
1) I can share a draft MAP workbook and SOW (will CC Monica and Marissa for pricing/legal hooks).
2) If this aligns, can you confirm procurement target date and whether Acme prefers PO or DocuSign SOW?

I attached a one-page pricing appendix and a short MAP workbook.

-best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: MAP draft + pricing — internal review (burst / termination)

Folks — forwarding Karthik's draft for internal sign-off. Key items that need finance/legal confirmation before we send final SOW to Acme: 
- Burst caps and pricing multiplier (1.5x vs 1.7x above cap). Recommend we hold to 1.5x for pilot but require explicit monthly cap in SOW.
- Early termination language: propose 60-day notice + pro-rated fee but allow a capped credit for migration assistance if Acme signs a 12-month renewal within 90 days of termination.
- Onboarding credit (10% first-month). Finance: confirm if that can be structured as a contra-revenue credit on first invoice or a deduction on the PO.

Also propose a small performance SLA for 99.9% availability during the pilot window; any SLA credits should be limited to service credit only (no direct refunds) to avoid legal pushback in pilot.

I'll attach an edited MAP and SOW draft (see attachments). If legal needs to review indemnity/limitation-of-liability language, we should include Priya on the next send.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
